representation_1_phase_sorted.name: Phase-Sorted Diagnostic Representation
representation_1_phase_sorted.sorting_principle: Cross-correlation lag relative to reference rhythm modulo cycle period
representation_1_phase_sorted.label: FIRING-PHASE ORDER — NOT ANATOMICAL POSITION
representation_1_phase_sorted.finding: Cross-correlation phase sorting mathematically forces a monotonic diagonal stripe for any multi-phase rhythmic population. It proves temporal phase diversity, NOT physical anatomical propagation.
representation_1_phase_sorted.author_code_evidence: @Network/PlotRaster.m line 20-21 shows the author commented out spatial sorting: '% [~,ix] = sort(obj.Position(:,3));' and substituted 'ix = ComputeFiringPhaseSorting(obj.Rates(2000:end,:));'. This routine was called in PlotRaster.m and PlotAnimatedNetworkEmgandPC.m to generate synthetic Poisson spike rasters, but neither routine generates the published Figure 3E composite.
representation_1_phase_sorted.scientific_rule: Never describe a smooth phase-sorted diagonal as proof of continuous physical propagation. Primary anatomical wave analysis must strictly preserve physical rostrocaudal position using Position(:, 2).

representation_2_anatomical_interneurons.name: Anatomically Sorted Interneurons
representation_2_anatomical_interneurons.finding: When analyzed in physical anatomical space using Position(:, 2), interneurons do NOT form a continuous smooth wave. Like motoneurons, interneurons exhibit stationary dwell fractions > 98%, low circular-linear correlations (R^2 = 0.123, p = 0.140 at 500 um bins), 36.2% skipped transitions at 500 um bins (71.6% skipped at 250 um bins), and repeated rostral-caudal cluster switching across cycles.

representation_3_anatomical_motoneurons.name: Anatomically Sorted Motoneurons
representation_3_anatomical_motoneurons.finding: Shows modular, columnar block-like activity corresponding to discrete motor pools, with sharp boundaries rather than a smooth continuous spatial wave.

representation_4_physical_rc_bins_and_po.name: Yakovenko-Style Motor Pool and Physical Bin Analysis
representation_4_physical_rc_bins_and_po.sorting_principle: Physical anatomical pool centroid (18 pools) and fixed-width physical bins (250, 500, 1000 um)
representation_4_physical_rc_bins_and_po.finding: Reveals bimodal/modular alternation between rostral flexor pools (TA, RF, VMed, Ilio) and caudal extensor pools (Sol, GM, BF, ST, EDL), with stationary dwell fractions > 98%.

within_cycle_jump_median_um.interpretation: Identical physical jump distance (553.3 um vs 554.2 um) corresponding to 2 bin intervals.

circular_linear_statistics.interpretation: Mardia-Jupp circular-linear correlation is low (R2 ~ 0.03-0.05, p > 0.3) due to discrete multi-pool coactivation and phase wrapping.

classification_options_evaluated.individual_neurons_sorted_by_firing_phas: Not proved. While ComputeFiringPhaseSorting exists in PlotRaster.m, that routine produces synthetic Poisson spike rasters (point scatter), not a continuous rate image. Furthermore, sorting individual neurons by phase lag would scramble segments across the vertical axis rather than producing the published 'Segments' (T13-S4) axis.
classification_options_evaluated.individual_neurons_sorted_anatomically: Not proved. Sorting 2,467 right-hemicord neurons strictly by Position(:,2) displays dense individual lines without the smooth continuous segmental bumps seen in published 3E.
classification_options_evaluated.anatomical_spatial_bins: Plausible candidate. Binning right-hemicord neurons into physical RC bins (e.g. 50-80 bins) along Position(:,2) reproduces smooth traveling bumps along the labeled 'Segments' axis.
classification_options_evaluated.segment_averaged_population_activity: Plausible candidate. Conforms to PlotNeurogram.m segmental summing/averaging logic across the 11 discrete segments (T13-S4).
classification_options_evaluated.unresolved_because_the_assembly_code_is_: FORMAL AUDIT CLASSIFICATION. The upstream repository BergLab/SpinalProjectome contains no Fig3.m driver script (MakeSummaryFigure.m is an empty 6-line stub). The exact mathematical ordering, spatial binning, and smoothing parameters of the published panel cannot be definitively proven.

3E.scientific_rule: Do not use phase sorting in the primary anatomical wave analysis. The primary analysis must preserve physical rostrocaudal position using Position(:,2). Never describe a smooth phase-sorted diagonal as proof of continuous physical propagation.

3F.variable: Polar phase relationships across steady-state cycles (iL2-cL2, iL2-iL5)
3F.author_routine: Circular phase analysis with explicit cycle boundaries
3F.discrepancies: Alternating bilateral phase (153.3 deg) and flexor-extensor phase (189.6 deg) match publication.

exhaustive_anatomical_wave_analysis.summary: Exhaustive continuity and wave kinematic audit across right/left motoneurons, right/left interneurons, all 8 interneuron classes, 18 motor pools, and 11 spinal segments across 250, 500, and 1000 um bin widths.
